Guillermo's own take for Thu, Oct 22 (his read, quote it as his, not yours): Northwest day, and Environment Canada has a gale coming: NW 15 to 25 this morning, 25 to 35 by early evening. Halibut Bank already reads W 11 gusting 13 at 5am, a little ahead of the page.

Jericho is my pick from about noon to 6pm with waves building late.  Ferry Terminal should also be about the same if you would want to sail in flat water. If the buoy reads 12+ from the west by 1pm, go.

EC marine forecast, Strait of Georgia (south of Nanaimo) (issued 04:00 PM PDT 22 October 2026), WARNING IN EFFECT: Tonight and Friday. Gale warning in effect.
